title: Prove sharp arbitrary-term cost 20 on one residual physical C5
body:
## Summary

```text
PR3268 residual physical C5 (10,12,23,35,16)
  six weighted forced identity blocks
  all 1,024 physical tariff inequalities
  arbitrary finite asymmetric cost >=20
  exact five-term fit attains20
```

Resolve this one named residual over Q, R or C with ordinary transpose and the inherited complete-plane tariff. The changed rank cover needs neither a term-count bound nor an equality-trace census. The four other residuals are outside this result and unassigned. Worker 4's separate scope concerns equality on already covered cores, not those residuals.

Only `research/c5-residual-weighted-cover/` is added. It contains the written proof, exact receipt, two implementations, controls, source pins, reproduction and Open next questions. Task `coverage-law-change`, explicitly changed to this local decoder obstruction, priority revision 6, canonical base `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`.

Credit thakrarsagar/PR3268 at `ee5d4f466e6e44a1897896324a36aa4c64cf3912` for the residual handoff and PR3256 for the earlier weighted-rank method; Tekalign/PR2782, Arham Tahir/PR2879, Sagar Thakrar/PR2484, Cinna Davis/PR1825, Adam Gall/PR1889, Nick Petalas/PR3248, PR3232, ctoth, Philippe Van Velzen and the retained E8/P112 geometry lineage. [Canonical predecessor investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19003538).

## Evidence

- Before, PR3268's fixed cover/trace certificate left this exact physical core open. After, a six-block integer cover has forced-rank sum20 and nonnegative margins on every ordered support pair. Exact asymmetric fits attain20.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay passes both implementations and eight optimized behavioral groups. The separate checker uses explicit binary vectors and dense elimination, with an independent ten-singleton upper bound. Source-corruption controls test both live inputs separately.
- Ruff `E,F,B,I,UP,C4,SIM`, formatting, warning-strict compilation and staged whitespace checks pass. All 12 committed package/input comparisons and archive integrity checks pass at `1bbe044ba2c7187dba149e40734179b2a1ebba84`. The exact committed read-only Git-free export passes all three scripts under optimized Python 3.13.
- Both live scientific inputs are canonical-main blobs. Fresh CI does not need a pending fork object or executable. Planning selects only this package. Final hosted CI is monitored separately; local success does not substitute for it.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/c5-residual-weighted-cover
```

No global decoder floor, native program, dirty restoration, complete hosting/precision invoice, supplier admission, new kappa or selected-frontier change. No selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, independent human or proof-kernel review was run. The submission overlap scan covers 316 open PRs and 2,108 Discussion records with complete pagination; arbitrary code diffs, unpublished work and all closed history are not exhausted.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

One opt-in research package. Shared verifiers, frozen predecessors and selected records are unchanged. Archival retention is not scientific admission.
